nodes.description: Private owner address of the Ownable contract; controls authorization for renounceOwnership/transferOwnership and is read by isOwner().
Address of the Rebased controller contract allowed (with owner) to call update(); access-control critical state variable.
Stored last cumulative price of the REB/ETH pair; subtracted from current cumulative price to compute averages.
Stored last cumulative price1 of the REB/ETH pair, updated together with price0.
Stored last block timestamp of the REB/ETH pair; used as time-denominator for TWAP computation.
Stored last cumulative price of the USDC/ETH pair; subtracted from current cumulative price.
Stored last cumulative price1 of the USDC/ETH pair.
Stored last block timestamp of the USDC/ETH pair; used as time-denominator.
IUniswapV2Pair reference to the REB/ETH pool; external target of price/reserve calls.
IUniswapV2Pair reference to the USDC/ETH pool; external target of price/reserve calls.
Ownable constructor; initializes _owner with msg.sender.
View function returning _owner; also used by onlyControllerOrOwner to compare msg.sender to owner.
View function comparing msg.sender to _owner; the authorization primitive of onlyOwner.
onlyOwner function that emits OwnershipRenounced and sets _owner to address(0).
onlyOwner function forwarding newOwner to internal _transferOwnership.
Internal function validating newOwner != 0 and writing _owner; the privileged state mutation.
RebasedOracle constructor; sets controller and pair references, and performs initial external calls to the Uniswap pairs to seed cumulative prices and timestamps.
Public view computing the REB/ETH TWAP from current cumulative prices and stored last-values.
Public view computing the USDC/ETH TWAP from current cumulative prices and stored last-values.
External, onlyControllerOrOwner function that writes new cumulative prices/timestamps into state.
External view Oracle entrypoint combining REB/ETH and USDC/ETH averages into the final USD price (division by usdcEthAverage).
Modifier guarding privileged Ownable functions via require(isOwner()).
Modifier guarding update() via require(msg.sender == controller || msg.sender == owner()).
Caller-controlled address used for ownership initialization, isOwner checks, controller checks and access to update().
Miner-influenceable timestamp used in timeElapsed and in the TWAP time denominators of the oracle rate computations.
External calls into the Uniswap pair for price0CumulativeLast(), price1CumulativeLast() and getReserves(); return values are trusted without validation.
Unchecked 0.5.17 subtractions priceCumulative - lastCumulative and blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast; underflow/overflow intentionally wrapped, breaks TWAP if mis-ordered.
Scaling multiplications and divisions (1e9/1e6 * cumulativeDelta / timeDelta, and rebEthAverage * 1e18 / usdcEthAverage) without zero/overflow checks.
Constructor parameter assigned to the access-control state variable controller.
Constructor parameter used to build the REB/ETH pair interface reference.
Constructor parameter used to build the USDC/ETH pair interface reference.
Parameter of the onlyOwner transferOwnership function; forwarded to _transferOwnership.
Internal parameter validated against address(0) and written to _owner.
Throwaway local receiving reserve0 from getReserves() in the constructor.
Throwaway local receiving reserve1 from getReserves() in the constructor.
Local receiving the REB/ETH average returned by getRebEthRate during update().
Local receiving the USDC/ETH average returned by getUsdcEthRate during update().
Local reused to hold the price0 cumulative values returned by the rate getters in getData().
Local reused to hold the price1 cumulative values returned by the rate getters in getData().
Local reused to hold the block timestamps returned by the rate getters in getData().
Local holding the REB/ETH average price inside getData().
Local holding the USDC/ETH average price inside getData() and used as division denominator.
Local holding the final scaled USD price answer returned by getData().
Local holding the current price0 cumulative from the REB/ETH pair oracle library call.
Local holding the current price1 cumulative from the REB/ETH pair oracle library call.
Local holding the truncated current block timestamp for the REB/ETH pair.
Local FixedPoint value holding the computed REB/ETH average before decoding.
Local holding the current price0 cumulative from the USDC/ETH pair oracle library call.
Local holding the current price1 cumulative from the USDC/ETH pair oracle library call.
Local holding the truncated current block timestamp for the USDC/ETH pair.
Local FixedPoint value holding the computed USDC/ETH average before decoding.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into _owner in the Ownable constructor, making the deployer the privileged account.
Ownable constructor initializes the _owner state variable.
isOwner reads _owner to compare against the caller.
isOwner compares the untrusted msg.sender with _owner: the sole authorization check.
onlyOwner modifier delegates to require(isOwner()).
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership permanently writes address(0) into _owner, disabling owner privileges.
_transferOwnership writes the new owner into the privileged _owner variable.
RebasedOracle constructor inherits Ownable which captures msg.sender as owner at deployment.
onlyOwner guards renounceOwnership.
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership.
transferOwnership consumes the newOwner parameter.
newOwner is forwarded from transferOwnership into _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership validates and writes its newOwner parameter.
msg.sender must satisfy isOwner for renounceOwnership to execute.
The constructor parameter _controller is written into the access-control state variable controller.
Constructor parameter __reb2_eth initializes the _reb2_eth pair reference.
Constructor parameter __usdc_reb initializes the _usdc_eth pair reference.
_dummy1 is a throwaway return slot used by the constructor's getReserves destructuring.
_dummy2 is a throwaway return slot used by the constructor's getReserves destructuring.
_reb2_eth is the external call target for price0CumulativeLast, price1CumulativeLast and getReserves.
_usdc_eth is the external call target for price0CumulativeLast, price1CumulativeLast and getReserves.
The constructor performs external Uniswap pair calls to seed initial oracle values.
Constructor stores the externally returned price0CumulativeLast into state.
Constructor stores the externally returned price1CumulativeLast into state.
Constructor stores the externally returned blockTimestampLast into reb2EthBlockTimestampLast.
Constructor stores the externally returned USDC/ETH price0CumulativeLast into state.
Constructor stores the externally returned USDC/ETH price1CumulativeLast into state.
Constructor stores the externally returned USDC/ETH blockTimestampLast into state.
onlyControllerOrOwner directly reads the controller state variable to authorize the caller.
onlyControllerOrOwner falls back to owner() to authorize the caller.
msg.sender is compared against controller and owner; it is the only gate on update().
update() is executed behind the onlyControllerOrOwner modifier.
Only msg.sender equal to controller or owner can reach update(), which mutates the oracle state.
update() calls getRebEthRate() to refresh the REB/ETH cumulative values.
update() calls getUsdcEthRate() to refresh the USDC/ETH cumulative values.
update() overwrites reb2EthPrice0CumulativeLast with fresh cumulative price data.
update() overwrites reb2EthPrice1CumulativeLast with fresh cumulative price data.
update() overwrites reb2EthBlockTimestampLast, the TWAP time reference.
update() overwrites usdcEthPrice0CumulativeLast with fresh cumulative price data.
update() overwrites usdcEthPrice1CumulativeLast with fresh cumulative price data.
update() overwrites usdcEthBlockTimestampLast, the TWAP time reference.
getRebEthRate returns the REB/ETH average into the update() local rebEthAverage.
getUsdcEthRate returns the USDC/ETH average into the update() local usdcEthAverage.
rebEthAverage is part of the tuple assigned to the REB/ETH last-state variables in update().
usdcEthAverage is part of the tuple assigned to the USDC/ETH last-state variables in update().
getData() invokes getRebEthRate() to read the REB/ETH TWAP.
getData() invokes getUsdcEthRate() to read the USDC/ETH TWAP.
getRebEthRate passes the _reb2_eth pair address into the oracle library call.
getUsdcEthRate passes the _usdc_eth pair address into the oracle library call.
currentCumulativePrices performs external pair calls whose values flow into getRebEthRate.
currentCumulativePrices performs external pair calls whose values flow into getUsdcEthRate.
price0Cumulative local is consumed by the REB/ETH average computation.
price1Cumulative local is consumed by the REB/ETH average computation.
_blockTimestamp local is used as the TWAP time numerator/denominator in getRebEthRate.
rebEthAverage local is the decoded value returned by getRebEthRate.
getRebEthRate builds the rebEthAverage FixedPoint local before decoding.
price0Cumulative local is consumed by the USDC/ETH average computation.
price1Cumulative local is consumed by the USDC/ETH average computation.
_blockTimestamp local is used as the TWAP time numerator/denominator in getUsdcEthRate.
usdcEthAverage local is the decoded value returned by getUsdcEthRate.
getUsdcEthRate builds the usdcEthAverage FixedPoint local before decoding.
Stored reb2EthPrice0CumulativeLast is subtracted from the current cumulative price in getRebEthRate.
reb2EthPrice0CumulativeLast feeds the unchecked subtraction producing the cumulative delta.
reb2EthBlockTimestampLast feeds the unchecked timeElapsed subtraction.
usdcEthPrice0CumulativeLast feeds the unchecked subtraction in getUsdcEthRate.
usdcEthBlockTimestampLast feeds the unchecked timeElapsed subtraction in getUsdcEthRate.
block.timestamp determines timeElapsed in the TWAP computation, making the price timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is the time denominator of the REB/ETH average rate.
block.timestamp is the time denominator of the USDC/ETH average rate.
The unchecked cumulative/time deltas are used to construct the REB/ETH average price.
The unchecked cumulative/time deltas are used to construct the USDC/ETH average price.
rebEthAverage is scaled by 1e18 inside the getData multiplication/division.
usdcEthAverage is the divisor in the final price computation, a potential division-by-zero path.
The getData local rebEthAverage is multiplied by 1e18 in the answer computation.
The getData local usdcEthAverage is used as the division denominator without a zero check.
The scaled multiplication/division result is stored in the answer local.
answer is returned by getData() to the oracle consumer (RebasedController).
_price0CumulativeLast local receives and is discarded within getData.
_price1CumulativeLast local receives and is discarded within getData.
_blockTimestampLast local receives and is discarded within getData.
rebEthAverage local is populated by the getRebEthRate call inside getData.
usdcEthAverage local is populated by the getUsdcEthRate call inside getData.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only exists to initialize the controller access-control state variable and has no independent behavior.
Constructor parameter only feeds the _reb2_eth pair reference assignment.
Constructor parameter only feeds the _usdc_eth pair reference assignment.
Parameter is immediately forwarded to _transferOwnership and adds no distinct semantics.
Parameter is validated and written to _owner; it is fully described by the internal transfer function.
Throwaway destructuring slot for reserve0 in the constructor's getReserves call.
Throwaway destructuring slot for reserve1 in the constructor's getReserves call.
Local only receives the getRebEthRate return tuple used to overwrite the REB/ETH state values in update().
Local only receives the getUsdcEthRate return tuple used to overwrite the USDC/ETH state values in update().
Ephemeral local that is overwritten twice and never returned by getData().
Ephemeral local that is overwritten twice and never returned by getData().
Ephemeral local that is overwritten twice and never returned by getData().
Local is an intermediate operand of the final scaled price computation in getData().
Local is the denominator of the final price division, directly tied to the division unsafe operation.
Local is the computed return value of getData(); it has no independent semantic role.
Local holds the external cumulative value used solely inside getRebEthRate's average computation.
Local holds the external cumulative value used solely inside getRebEthRate's average computation.
Local holds the timestamp used as the TWAP time base inside getRebEthRate.
Local is the FixedPoint result built and immediately decoded in getRebEthRate.
Local holds the external cumulative value used solely inside getUsdcEthRate's average computation.
Local holds the external cumulative value used solely inside getUsdcEthRate's average computation.
Local holds the timestamp used as the TWAP time base inside getUsdcEthRate.
Local is the FixedPoint result built and immediately decoded in getUsdcEthRate.
